title: Body-fitted tracking of 2d open curves with a level set based mesh evolution method
summary: This article describes a novel numerical algorithm for tracking the motion of a collection of open curves in two space dimensions. The proposed strategy combines two complementary representations of these curves at each iteration of the evolution process: on the one hand, they are meshed explicitly, as a sub-collection of the entities of a mesh of the total computational domain.
